title: Reconcile Conflicting Status
scenario: Two sources disagree about hardware: the automation marked it done, but the IT Provisioner says it is blocked. The gate cannot act on a contradiction. Reconcile the tracker with an explicit tie-break rule - the conservative state holds until confirmed - so the gate reads one truth.
input:
Status reports for hire H-4021:
accounts -> done (agreed)
hardware -> automation says done, IT Provisioner says blocked (CONFLICT)
access -> done (agreed)
payroll -> done (agreed)
Tie-break rule: on conflict, the CONSERVATIVE state (blocked) holds until a human confirms done. Set hardware blocked with reason 'conflicting reports; held pending confirmation'. The rest are done with empty reason.
instructions: Set accounts, access, payroll to done with empty blockedReason.
Reconcile hardware to blocked with reason 'conflicting reports; held pending confirmation'.
Return a JSON array of the four rows, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Reconcile a tracker with a conflict: accounts, access, payroll done; hardware conflicting (automation done vs owner blocked). Apply the conservative tie-break: hardware blocked with reason 'conflicting reports; held pending confirmation'.
successMessage: Conflict reconciled. The conservative state holds, so the gate reads one truth, not a contradiction.
editorHelper: On conflict, hold the conservative state until confirmed.

sections.title: Sources disagree
sections.body: Automation and a human can report different states. The tracker cannot hold both - the gate needs a single value. Reconciliation is deciding which source wins, by rule, not by mood.

sections.title: Conservative until confirmed
sections.body: When safety is at stake, the cautious state holds: blocked beats done until a human confirms. Assuming done and being wrong sends an unready hire through; holding is recoverable.

sections.title: Record why
sections.body: The reason names the conflict, so the hold is not a mystery. A blocked state that explains itself is one a reviewer can resolve quickly.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A reconciled tracker with one authoritative state per task - the contradiction resolved by an explicit rule.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd treat a disputed item as not-done until someone confirmed it, and note the disagreement so it gets resolved.

tools.powerAutomate: a rule preferring the blocked report on conflict, with a reason
tools.zapier: compare the two sources; keep the conservative value

takeaway.heading: Conflict reconciled
points: You resolved a two-source conflict with an explicit tie-break rule.
The conservative state (blocked) held until a human confirms done.
The reason names the conflict so it can be resolved fast.
The gate now reads one authoritative state per task, not a contradiction.
The workflow can now reconcile disagreeing status reports safely.
